summary: ReturnRide iteration 2: 15/15 new backend tests PASS for POOLING and ADMIN CONSOLE (see /app/backend/tests/test_admin_pooling.py). Pooling: /api/rides/match returns estimated_fare, estimated_fare_pooled (~12% lower), pooled_savings>0, co_riders (int). POST /api/bookings with pooled:true persists a lower estimated_fare AND fare_breakdown.pool_discount > 0; non-pooled has pool_discount==0. Admin AuthZ: passenger + driver -> 403 on /api/admin/stats,users,bookings,settings. Admin Users: filter role=driver works; block flow verified end-to-end (register -> login 200 -> admin block with reason -> login 403 -> admin unblock -> login 200); role change, verify, reset_password (login with new pwd 200) and soft delete all work. Admin Bookings: list filter+detail (timeline present, no OTP leak, otp_result field present) + force-cancel with reason 200, second cancel -> 400 already closed. Admin Logs: list & filter, /logs/export returns text/csv with CSV header. Admin Settings: GET returns all six fare knobs; PUT persists pool_discount/rate_per_km; GET reflects them; restored after test. Frontend Pooling E2E (mobile 390x844): passenger 8000000001/demo1234 -> book-ride-cta -> location-picker -> confirm-pickup at Shirwal default -> search 'Wai' + suggestion-0 (landmark chip Wai Market was off-screen in horizontal ScrollView) -> confirm-drop -> find-rides -> 3 matches. pool-switch present and toggling drops fare ₹171.36 → ₹150.8 (~12%), 'Save ₹20.56' badge + 'Return · 25% Off' badge + '2 Riders On Board' visible. book-{rideId} navigated to /ride/{id}. Admin console UI was not deep-tested via Playwright (mobile time budget exhausted) but its backend contract is fully covered by the pytest suite; admin-shell renders sidebar at >=900px per code inspection.

ui_bugs.issue: Landmark chip row is a horizontal ScrollView on 390px viewport — 'Wai Market' chip is not visible without horizontal scroll; automated scrollIntoView on the chip's inner Text fails. Search-input flow works fine. Consider making chip row wrap OR give each chip a stable testID='landmark-{name}' so tests can locate reliably.

issues: Same RN Web deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional UX) In app/location-picker.tsx add wrapping option or per-landmark stable testID so E2E can select 'Wai Market' without horizontal scroll gymnastics.
(Optional) Migrate deprecated RN web props (shadow*, pointerEvents) to silence warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py: PATCH /users combines multi-field updates into ONE action string (overwrites earlier action var). If admin sends {status:'blocked', role:'driver'} in a single payload, only the last one is logged. Consider logging one audit entry per field, or a composite action.

admin.py force_cancel closes 'completed/cancelled/rejected' bookings — good; also decrements no seat on force-cancel (unlike passenger/driver cancel which restores seat via bookings.py). Consider restoring the seat when force-cancelling accepted/en_route/arrived rides.
rides.py match now computes pooled_fare and co_riders on every candidate — fine at 300-ride limit, but could add index on rides.status/seats_available for scale.

bookings.py serialize() correctly gates OTP by state+viewer; admin never sees OTP value (verified by pytest); admin_booking_detail also strips otp by using oid_str on raw doc which still contains 'otp' — SECURITY BUG! admin.py line 159 returns oid_str(doc) directly and doc has 'otp' plaintext. Test test_list_and_detail_and_force_cancel asserts 'otp' not in body — it PASSED, so oid_str likely already excludes; but recommend an explicit doc.pop('otp',None) and doc.pop('otp_hash',None) for defense in depth.

success_rate.frontend: Pooling flow verified end-to-end on mobile; admin console UI not exercised in this run (backend-verified)
